title: Listen and choose 1.2
role: Event coordinator briefing a colleague on what is certain and what is not
can_do: I can say how sure I am about a plan or an event.
I can use likely, probable and certain in clear, precise sentences.

items.prompt: What does the speaker think about the ferry?
items.explanation: Unlikely means it will probably not happen.

items.prompt: How sure is the speaker that the minister will open the conference?
items.explanation: Almost certain is a very high degree of certainty.

options.text: Keep the plan ready just in case

items.explanation: The speaker says to keep it ready in case the storm moves north.
